name: Three-ply cord at Abri du Maras
description: A small fragment on a stone flake from Abri du Maras was interpreted as three-ply plant-fibre cord.

date.label: Approximately 54,000–39,000 years BP, contextual age envelope
date.basis: Approximate envelope of three reported central dates and their ± uncertainties, converted from BP using 1950; it does not date the cord directly.

events.statement: A small fragment on a stone flake from Abri du Maras was interpreted as three-ply plant-fibre cord.

evidence.supports: The authors report a tiny three-ply cord fragment adhering to a flake from level 4.2; separate contextual age estimates are 41±2, 46±5 and 52±2 thousand years. They interpret the fibres as inner bark of a gymnosperm, probably conifer.

events.caveats: Contextual ESR and uranium-series age estimates for level 4.2 are 41±2, 46±5 and 52±2 thousand years; the displayed approximate envelope spans those estimates and is not a direct date of the cord. The authors identify likely gymnosperm inner-bark fibres. The original purpose is unknown.
